message: So, I was chatting with my neighbor the other day, and she mentioned how she has an escape plan mapped out for every room in her house. I thought it was a bit much at first, but then I remembered the time I almost burned the toast and set off our smoke alarm—everyone was scrambling around like it was a fire drill! Having a plan, even if it feels gloriously over-prepared, could save some chaos. Anyone else have an amusing escape plan story?
